items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1964-11-28
items.q: They worked it up on their arrangement, Barney and Seymour.

ctx.x: That's all it is too. But it's a great strain.

Well, he worked it up. Of course, there were others that worked it up into a, an instrumental piece, you know, the St. Louis Tickle uses it as an instrumental, they use a strain, but not, not like Telly Rhodes exactly. They worked it up on their arrangement, Barney and Seymour. But, to work it up and put the words to it that, that he did, some, some like, what were being used around him, some I think he cooked up himself. They, I had to laugh about the use of words, you know, this, this twist, when the dance came…
